Photo 1: Same cooker from front; shows 4 gas burners with blue flames lit; also shows 2 electric/solid hotplate-style circles in the middle.
Photo 2: Side/back view of the cooker body; no readable brand/model label; no clear oven/grill cavity details.

identity.kind: 4-burner gas cooker with 2 electric hotplates (hybrid hob)

claims.claim: 4 Gas cooker and 2 burner making 6 burner in total.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 4 gas burners; Photo 1 shows 2 additional hotplate circles (not clearly gas burners, but they are 2 additional burners/heat zones).
Photo 1 shows flames/hot zones lit at the time of the photo, but there is no proof of long-term performance, ignition reliability, or that every burner works under normal load.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: No readable date/receipt/warranty details are visible in the provided photos.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened.

No receipt/warranty card is shown or readable in the photos.

risks.risk: The 2 middle 'burners' may be electric hotplates (not gas). If you need 6 gas burners, this would be a mismatch.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing each of the 2 middle zones turning on and heating (and confirm whether they are electric hotplates or gas burners).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a 4-gas-burner cooker (worst case for the '6 gas burners' expectation).

risks.risk: Only some burners may be working reliably; photos show them lit once, not that they stay stable or ignite every time.
risks.proof: Ask for a video where all 4 gas burners are ignited one-by-one from cold, then adjusted from low to high for 2–3 minutes each.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed perfect working (worst case: treat as used with possible minor faults).

risks.risk: Missing/unclear oven/grill function: seller text doesn’t clearly match what’s shown; photos don’t confirm an oven/grill cavity.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo/video opening any oven/grill door and showing the cavity and burner/heating element (if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as hob-only functionality (no confirmed oven/grill).

risks.risk: Brand/model and condition cannot be verified remotely; could be a lower-grade unit or have cosmetic/structural issues not visible.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the brand/model label and serial plate (if any) plus a photo of the underside/legs and any dents.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end of comparable used table-top gas cookers.

proof_requests: Video: ignite all 4 gas burners from cold, then demonstrate low-to-high adjustment for each (2–3 minutes each).
Confirm the 2 middle zones: are they electric hotplates or gas burners? Provide a video showing them heating and how they are powered/controlled.
Clear close-up photo of brand/model label/serial plate (and any rating plate).
Photos of receipt and warranty card (readable), or a screenshot/scan showing the details.
response.reason: Photos show a table-top cooker with 4 gas burners plus 2 additional heat zones, but the 'perfect working' and 'barely used/new last year' parts are not provable from images. I will price it at worst-case as a used 4-gas-burner cooker without confirmed oven/grill and without assuming perfect condition.
